 Advertisement Updated: 11:54 AM EDT Oct 26, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Bradley Shimel Sports Reporter Former ABC7 Sports Director and Radio Host David Moulton passes away at 59
 Updated: 11:54 AM EDT Oct 26, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Bradley Shimel Sports Reporter FORT MYERS, Fla. — Former ABC7 Sports Director and radio co-host of the "Miller and Moulton" show David Moulton has passed away at the age of 59.
 David faced a six-year battle with cancer and passed this weekend while in hospice care at the Douglas Center for Caring.
 Advertisement He arrived in Fort Myers in the late nineties as a sports anchor and went on to have a stellar career in sports media.
 From serving as a spotter for Joe Buck and Troy Aikman to becoming the voice of FGCU Athletics, David was a friendly face who was loved by so many across the Gulf Coast.
 All of us at Gulf Coast News send our condolences to David's family and friends during this difficult time.
